verdict.rationale: The pack contains only Apple's own marketing claims about general performance and efficiency (e.g., apple-m4-pro-docs-3, apple-m4-pro-docs-12) with no independent single-thread benchmark data (e.g., Geekbench single-core scores) to substantiate 'instant' interactive performance; community comments even question the validity of Apple's own comparisons (apple-m4-pro-comm-2, apple-m4-pro-comm-4, apple-m4-pro-comm-6) rather than provide corroborating third-party numbers. missing for 10: independent single-thread benchmark results, hands-on interactive-responsiveness testing, comparison to competitor chips' single-core scores.
